title: Measurement envelope v1
description: The one wire format every collector (web app, mobile app, Go gateway) publishes to v1/{tenant}/{user}/{device_id}/measurement/{type} and the backend re-publishes unchanged to live/{owner_user_id}/{device_id}/{type}. This file is the single source of truth: gateway/internal/envelope (Go), backend ingest/MeasurementEnvelope (Java) and fe/src/live/mqttClient.ts (TypeScript) each carry a test that validates their own encoder/decoder output against it. Change the format here first, then the three implementations and their tests.

device_id.description: The device's Bluetooth device address as the collector saw it (devices.bd_addr, VARCHAR(17)).

collector_id.description: Free-form identifier of the collector that produced the reading (measurements.collector_id, VARCHAR(128)).

ts.description: Reading timestamp, RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 with offset (UTC 'Z' preferred).

type.description: Measurement type. Registered types have a fixed payload shape (see allOf); unknown types are stored verbatim with no primary scalar.

payload.description: Typed measurement document; must not be empty.

meta.description: Optional collector-side context (battery, RSSI, firmware version...). Omitted, not null, when absent.
